name: Restic backup
author: Helder Henrique
description: Last restic snapshot and a 7-day backup heatmap in a native Omarchy bar panel.

barWidget.description: Shows when the last snapshot ran, what it added, and which of the last 7 days have a backup.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Each refresh runs `restic snapshots`, which opens the repository (slow KDF + network). The panel shows cached data instantly in between.

schema.label: Stale after (days)
schema.description: Flag the backup as overdue when the last snapshot is at least this old.

schema.label: Restic env file
schema.description: Optional. File with RESTIC_REPOSITORY / RESTIC_PASSWORD / B2_* lines. Defaults to ~/.restic-env when the variables aren't already in the shell's environment.
